name: Thabbashite Seer
subtitle: using his powers for villainy
rules: [D][D][V][V] – When this card enters play, leaves play, attacks, or blocks, you may look at the top card of any deck. -- FLIP UP – 1 [V][V][V][V]
flavor: The seers of the Doarden tribes lose their eyes at an early age, but gain a new kind of sight in exchange.

name: Trickster's Globe
subtitle: shake it up and lose your mind
rules: If you would inflict damage to an opponent's faction, for each damage you would inflict, you may put up to that many cards from the top of its owner's deck into their discard pile instead. -- When a player has no cards in their deck, they lose the game.

name: Unchained Sarcophyle
subtitle: doom bringer
rules: FLIP UP – 8 [D]
flavor: Mutations, albeit uncommon, are known to exist among the Sarcophyle classes. First the mind rots; then the body revolts.

name: Wary Reunion
subtitle: teamwork will get us there!
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- Remove the character from the game if it has X life or less, where X is the number of different trades you control. -- FLIP UP – 2 [D]
notes: Card prints 'the number of different trades you control'; catalog has 'trades among cards you control' (clarifying templating, same play).

name: Arcane Ambush
subtitle: "it's going to explode!"
rules: EXTRA COST – Play this only during your turn. Pick a faction. -- Destroy all items and locations. If you control cards with 'UNIQUE JO', 'UNIQUE EUSTACE', 'UNIQUE PLUCK', 'UNIQUE RUDOLPHUS', and 'UNIQUE IGNATIOUS', inflict 15 damage to the faction and each character that faction's controller controls. -- FLIP UP – 6 [O][G][E][D][R]

name: Quilt of Old Banners
subtitle: remains from the descent
rules: UNIQUE QUILT -- When this card enters play and at the start of each of your turns, name a non-[V] resource icon. X is that icon. Until the start of your next turn, this card gains "PROVIDES - X". -- HAND IT DOWN -- COST – Pay 1. Shuffle this card into its owner's deck. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.

name: Soulsearcher
rules: [O] – This card gains COVERT. -- [G] – This card gains 2 life. -- [E] – This card gains AGGRO. -- [D] – This card gains 1 speed. -- [R] – This card gains 2 strength.

name: Wasteland
subtitle: in the end, everything turned to dust
rules: UNIQUE WASTELAND -- When this card is inflicted damage by a character, destroy the character. -- At the start of your turn, put a token on this card. -- When there are at least 3 tokens on this card, void all non-resource cards.
flavor: The Blades escaped, just barely, but left behind a terrorscape filled with unspeakable horrors.

name: Zenobia's Succor
subtitle: "i've been expecting you. you are our only hope."
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- [O] – This turn, the character gains COVERT. -- [G] – This turn, the character gains 2 life. -- [E] – This turn, the character gains AGGRO. -- [D] – This turn, the character gains 1 speed. -- [R] – This turn, the character gains 2 strength.

name: Zigalburgonglgr, the Stolen God
subtitle: it only eats and sleeps and releases
rules: When this card enters play, you may put a token on up to X non-resource cards, where X is the number of [V] you control. -- When this card is destroyed, destroy all non-resource cards with tokens on them. -- TURN TO MUSH -- COST - Pay 2. Pick a card with a token on it. -- EFFECT - Flip the card face-down under its owner's control.
printing: Alternate full-art frame with Ungodly Mess logo; footer reads 'SUPER RARE 6 of 6'; no copyright line or set-number badge
notes: Non-standard full-bleed layout; footer text 'SUPER RARE 6 0f 6' (typo for 'of').

name: Abusive Major General
subtitle: considered nice by all imperial standards
rules: BLEED -- COST – Pick a character in battle. Destroy a resource you control. -- EFFECT – Inflict 2 damage to the character.
flavor: Barduse feed on friendly flesh nearly as often as that of the enemy.

name: Auditory Adulation
subtitle: "i'm coming for you, brother!"
rules: EXTRA COST – Deploy this only not during a battle. Pick a character. -- This turn, the character gains strength equal to its numeric cost. You may play a resource. -- FLIP UP – 3 [R]

name: Big McLargehuge
rules: UNIQUE MCLARGEHUGE -- EXTRA COST – Destroy 2 resources you control. -- When this card leaves play, you may play a resource or pick an opponent and that player destroys a face-down resource they control. -- FLIP UP – 4 [R]
flavor: The name Bladefist Doomwing was already taken.

name: Bloodcrazed Berserker
subtitle: i'd be scared of me, too
rules: HEMORAGE -- COST – Destroy this card. Pick a faction or character. -- EFFECT – Inflict 4 damage to that card. -- FLIP UP – 4 [R]

name: Breath of the Barduse
subtitle: indiscriminate carnage
rules: EXTRA COST – Deploy this only during your turn. -- Each player destroys 2 characters they own. Otherwise, destroy all of that player's characters.
notes: Catalog typo: '2 character they own' vs printed '2 characters they own'.

name: Bursting Bask
subtitle: it's gonna blow!
rules: [R][R][R][R][R][R] – When this card enters play, you may pick a character. If you do, inflict 5 damage to it. -- FLIP UP – 4 [R][R][R]

name: Corrosive Waste Dispenser
subtitle: voidal waste remover
rules: This card enters play with 4 tokens on it. -- When this card has no tokens on it, flip it face-down under its owner's control. -- CONVERT -- COST – Pay 1. Remove a token from this card. Destroy a non-"micromajig" character you control. -- EFFECT – Each opponent destroys a character they control.
notes: Card's CONVERT cost includes 'Pay 1.' before 'Remove a token from this card'; catalog cost omits 'Pay 1.' (known wrong-version text).

name: Crimson Pandiatus
subtitle: eternal enemy of the cucurbita pepo
rules: This character cannot attack. -- [R][R][R][R][R][R] – This card gains 4 life and loses all other rules text.
flavor: It wasn't until the Pandiatus Army discovered the surprising side effects of Voidal Bamboo that the tides of war turned.

name: Difference of Opinion
subtitle: a pluck and a chum walk onto a battlefield
rules: You may pick a character. If you do, inflict 1 damage to the character. If you control an attacking party of at least 2 members, you may pick a character. If you do, inflict 2 damage to the character. -- FLIP UP – 4 [R] and you may pick an item. If you do, destroy it.

name: Direstock Paratrooper
subtitle: daggers from above
rules: FLIP UP – 1 [R]
flavor: In warfare, Dragon Riders will leap from their steeds to rain fury from the skies, confident that their dragon partners will be ready to swoop them up before they splatter on the ground. Which they do. Usually.

name: Direstock Stronghold
subtitle: a nigh-impregnable fortress-city complex
rules: UNIQUE STRONGHOLD -- At the end of your turn, you may search your deck for a Warlord character and reveal it. If you do, put it on top of your deck. -- When you deploy a character, X is that character's numeric cost and you may pick a faction. If you do, inflict X damage to that faction and put X damage markers on this card.

name: Disposable Meatsack
subtitle: every army has them
rules: At the end of your turn, if this card is depleted, destroy it. -- [R][R][R][R][R][R] – This card gains 1 strength and 1 speed.
flavor: The Thabbashites killed Imperial Army and Counter-Imperial Army nondiscriminately in defense of their god.
notes: Card says 'This card gains 1 strength and 1 speed'; catalog says 'This character gains ...' (same referent).

name: Geldale, City-Fortress
subtitle: counter-imperial army stronghold
rules: Your opponents may only play tactics during their own turn.
flavor: Located in the forests of Yenassa at the base of Elzibeth's Peak, the rangers of Geldale have protected the forest against monsters, invasions and monstrous invasions for generations.
notes: Catalog typo: 'You opponents' vs printed 'Your opponents'.

name: God's Blessing of Boost
subtitle: the living god empowers
rules: UNIQUE BLESSING -- ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- When this card enters play, inflict 1 damage to all characters. -- The attached character gains the following rules text: "At the start of each turn, inflict 1 damage to all your characters. -- All your characters gain 1 strength."

name: Gor-blach the Endowed
subtitle: thabbashite champion
rules: UNIQUE GOR-BLACH -- GET IN THERE – [V][V][V] -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a blocked character you control. X is its strength. Pay X. -- EFFECT – Destroy the character. Inflict X damage to an opponent's faction. Inflict X damage to this card.

name: Gosche's Restoration Fortress
subtitle: regenerative voidal experimentation
rules: When a character you control with a token on it leaves play, you may pick a character with less strength than that character had and restore it. -- IMPLANT -- COST – Deplete this card. Pay 2. Pick a character you control. -- EFFECT – Put a token on that character.
notes: Card prints 'less strength than that character had'; catalog omits 'had' (last-known strength of the departed character vs. its current strength could change play).

name: Gosche's Voidal Frequency Emission
subtitle: like shrievers to an emission device
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character in your discard pile. -- Draw a card. Put the character on top of its owner's deck or into play under its owner's control as a face-down resource. -- FLIP UP – 2 [R]

name: Headshot
subtitle: boom! (x4)
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- Inflict 1 damage to that character. If it is destroyed by that damage, you may pick a character. -- Repeat this effect up to three more times. -- FLIP UP – 4 [R]
notes: Card: 'Inflict 1 damage to that character. If it is destroyed by that damage, you may pick a character. Repeat this effect up to three more times.' Catalog spells out a chained 'pick another character and inflict 1 damage' sequence (known wrong-version text); wording and structure differ.

name: Malevolent Trooper
subtitle: welcome to the brigade, kid!
rules: PUSH -- COST – Pay 1. Deplete a character you control. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains 2 strength.
notes: Image shows 2 threshold icons (rr); catalog threshold has 3 (rrr).

name: Readied Rifleman
subtitle: wait for the headshot
rules: When this card is restored, you may pick a faction. If you do, inflict 1 damage to it.
flavor: The Imperial Army fought Thabbashite, Expedition, and Unlikely Hero alike for control over the Living God, utilizing units of all kinds in the effort.

name: Rudo Mangod, Fightful Adonis
typeLine: WARLORD CHARACTER – rudo, blade of questionable morality
rules: UNIQUE RUDOLPHUS -- Fealty - While this card is in your hand and you control at least 4 staple resources of different trades, reduce this card's threshold requirement by any 3 resource icons. -- When this card attacks, you may pay 2. If you do, each character you control gains 2 strength this turn. -- When this card is destroyed, you may search your deck for a Warlord character and reveal it. If you do, put it on top of your deck.

name: Salvo Sarume
subtitle: most sarumes have cunning intelligence
rules: When this card inflicts battle damage to a faction, you may put a resource you control into its owner's hand. If you do, inflict 1 damage to all characters.
flavor: Others have dynamite strapped to their backs.

name: Severed Limb

notes: Stat bubbles show modifiers +1 STR, +0 LIFE, +0 SPD (recorded as null since this is an item).

name: Silencer

subtitle: symbiosis gives him strength

name: Thabbashite Weapons Expert
subtitle: jerry-rigging!?
rules: At the start of your turn, X is this card's strength and you may destroy this character. If you do, inflict X damage to each opponent's faction or pick an item with numeric cost X or less and destroy it. -- [V][V][V][V][V] – This card gains 2 strength.
